newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Human hits high after H1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Human hits high after H1 earnings.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Human Rt climbed to a new record high of 4,180 forints on Friday and traders said prospects more than earnings were behind the rise.
"My feeling is that investors assess its earnings mixed," a trader said. "Some say the earnings are not bad, while others don't regard them good but see growth potential (in its price)."
Human reported a consolidated after-tax profit of 497.4 million forints for the first six months of 1997, compared to 407.4 million in the corresponding period of 1996.
At 1003 GMT it traded at 4,150 forints, up 100.
Another trader said the stock had stable demand at around 4,000 forint.
"I don't think its earnings heated investors up," one trader said. "Tight supply has also contributed to its strengthening."
